words.example_en: Environmental organizations work globally to protect endangered forest wildlife species.
words.example_tr: Çevre örgütleri, nesli tükenmekte olan orman yaban hayatı türlerini korumak için küresel çapta çalışır.

words.example_en: Governments pass strict laws to preserve natural national parks for future generations.
words.example_tr: Hükümetler, gelecek nesiller için doğal milli parkları korumak adına katı yasalar çıkarır.

words.example_en: Citizens must learn to conserve water and electrical energy during severe summer droughts.

words.example_en: Industrial factories emit toxic chemical waste that can heavily pollute clean rivers.

words.example_en: Agricultural chemical fertilizers can accidentally contaminate underground drinking water sources.
words.example_tr: Tarımsal kimyasal gübreler, yeraltı içme suyu kaynaklarını kazara kirletebilir.

words.example_en: Modern urban communities encourage residents to sort and recycle plastic waste products.

words.example_en: Eco-friendly shoppers prefer to reuse durable fabric bags instead of buying plastic ones.

words.example_en: Wildfires can rapidly destroy vast areas of green mountain forests.

words.example_en: Single-use plastics discarded in oceans can seriously harm marine animals.

words.example_en: Leaving running taps open while brushing teeth can waste precious natural water.

words.example_en: School volunteers gather every spring to plant new trees in city parks.

words.example_en: Local farmers grow organic vegetables without using harmful chemical pesticides.

words.example_en: Many polar animals struggle to survive as arctic sea ice melts away.

words.example_en: Rising global temperatures seriously threaten natural coral reef ecosystems worldwide.

words.example_en: Animal rescue teams work tirelessly to save injured birds from oil spills.

words.example_en: Healthy green forests naturally absorb massive quantities of carbon dioxide gas.

words.example_en: Biologists constantly explore deep rainforests to discover unknown plant species.

words.example_en: Many animal species must adapt quickly to rapidly changing weather climates.
words.example_tr: Birçok hayvan türü hızla değişen hava iklimlerine hızlıca uyum sağlamak zorundadır.

words.example_en: Global weather patterns continue to change dramatically over recent decades.
words.example_tr: Küresel hava örüntüleri son on yıllarda dramatik bir şekilde değişmeye devam ediyor.

words.example_en: Severe environmental pollution can negatively affect local wildlife food chains.

words.example_en: Industrial deforestation practices heavily impact natural bird nesting habitats.

words.example_en: Conservationists work hard to restore damaged wetlands and natural river banks.

words.example_en: Countries try to renew energy policies by adopting solar and wind power.

words.example_en: Cities plant rooftop gardens to transform gray concrete landscapes into green spaces.

words.example_en: Parks departments maintain clean walking trails and green picnic areas.

words.example_en: Rare forest habitats might completely disappear if deforestation continues unchecked.

words.example_en: Dense green pine forests completely surround the quiet mountain lake.

words.example_en: Protected marine life species flourish inside safe coral reef reservation zones.
